title: Bookwise launches full accounting solution for Dutch company groups
content_html: Bookwise went live on 1 October 2026. The new software is designed for Dutch company groups that consist of a holding BV and any number of operating BVs. It offers full double-entry bookkeeping with period locking. Sales and purchase invoices are posted to the ledger with BTW. The system generates quarterly and annual BTW returns, including reverse charge and intra-EU adjustments. Profit and loss statements and balance sheet reports are available for each company and for the group as a whole. A compliance calendar tracks BTW, VPB, annual accounts and KvK deadlines. Roles can be set per company: owner, accountant, employee or viewer. A group dashboard shows the status of all companies in one view. New companies start with a Dutch chart of accounts and BTW codes automatically.
